source_context: GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT continued Direction D from the accepted discriminant-tower reduction and formalized a reusable explicit cyclotomic-eight layer. In CyclotomicField 8 Q it defines a primitive eighth root zeta and the elements zeta+zeta^7 and zeta-zeta^7, proves their squares are 2 and -2, uses Eisenstein at 2 to prove their exact minimal polynomials X^2-2 and X^2+2 over Q, and records that the ambient eighth cyclotomic field has degree 4 and absolute discriminant 256. Internally the development also verifies that the generated quadratic subfields have degree 2, generate the full ambient field, and are linearly disjoint, but those implementation-heavy statements are kept private because the receiver's normalized-term budget is exceeded by their concrete IntermediateField types. This submission is a self-contained structural milestone toward the final discriminant-tower witness; the remaining future step is to identify the rings of integers / absolute discriminants of the two quadratic subfields as 8 and then apply the accepted loadBearing_of_witness theorem. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected and authored the contribution; the human did not materially edit it. No claim of new mathematics is made.
